# PeachPrep RE

> Free Georgia real estate exam prep — a free practice quiz and the PeachPrep RE iOS app with 1,900+ GA-specific practice questions, 400+ flashcards, and full 152-question PSI-style timed simulations.

Exam-format facts on these pages (152 questions = 100 national + 52 Georgia supplement, both portions scored separately at 75%, 4-hour limit, administered by PSI) are verified against the official PSI/GREC candidate information bulletin.

## Study guides & exam facts

- [Georgia Real Estate Exam Vocabulary: 50 Terms You Need to Know](https://peachprepre.com/vocab.html): The 50 most-tested Georgia real estate exam terms — from BRRETA, brokerage engagements, and designated agency to security deeds, the intangible recording tax, and Georgia's power-of-sale foreclosure — with plain-English, exam-focused definitions organized by topic. Includes the Georgia-only concepts national prep material skips.

## Interactive

- [Free Georgia Real Estate Practice Exam](https://peachprepre.com/quiz.html): Take our free 20-question Georgia real estate practice exam. Find your weak spots across key GA exam topics and see exactly where to focus your studying. No email required.
- [Georgia Real Estate Exam Study Guides](https://peachprepre.com/guides.html): Free GA real estate exam study guides. Georgia PSI-specific resources to help you pass on the first try.

## App

- [PeachPrep RE on the App Store](https://peachprepre.com/): iOS app with 1,900+ Georgia-specific practice questions, flashcards, and timed exam simulations — built for the GA PSI salesperson exam. Includes an 11-question FAQ on Georgia exam format, scoring, and difficulty.

## Support

- [Support & FAQs](https://peachprepre.com/support.html): Help with the PeachPrep RE app — free tier limits, Pro and Premium upgrades, and contact info.
